// ##CROSS: library deployment
package bindtest

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"math/big"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/accounts/abi/bind"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/accounts/abi/bind/backends"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/types"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/crypto"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type delayedBackend struct {
	bind.ContractBackend
	nonce    uint64
	queries  int
	sent     []*types.Transaction
	nonceErr error
	sendErr  error
	failAt   int
	ctx      context.Context
}

// PendingNonceAt keeps reporting the same nonce even after successful submissions.
func (b *delayedBackend) PendingNonceAt(ctx context.Context, _ common.Address) (uint64, error) {
	b.queries++
	b.ctx = ctx
	return b.nonce, b.nonceErr
}

// SendTransaction records submissions and optionally forwards them to a simulated chain.
func (b *delayedBackend) SendTransaction(ctx context.Context, tx *types.Transaction) error {
	b.sent = append(b.sent, tx)
	if b.sendErr != nil && len(b.sent)-1 == b.failAt {
		return b.sendErr
	}
	if b.ContractBackend != nil {
		return b.ContractBackend.SendTransaction(ctx, tx)
	}
	return nil
}

func deploymentAuth(t *testing.T) *bind.TransactOpts {
	t.Helper()
	key, err := crypto.GenerateKey()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	auth, err := bind.NewKeyedTransactorWithChainID(key, big.NewInt(1337))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	auth.GasLimit = 300000
	auth.GasPrice = big.NewInt(2000000000)
	return auth
}

func checkDeployment(t *testing.T, from common.Address, nonce uint64, txs []*types.Transaction) {
	t.Helper()
	require.Len(t, txs, 4)
	leaf := crypto.CreateAddress(from, nonce)
	first := crypto.CreateAddress(from, nonce+1)
	second := crypto.CreateAddress(from, nonce+2)
	wantData := [][]byte{
		common.FromHex(LeafBin),
		append(common.FromHex("6015600c60003960156000f300"), leaf.Bytes()...),
		common.FromHex(SecondBin),
		append(append(common.FromHex("6029600c60003960296000f300"), first.Bytes()...), second.Bytes()...),
	}
	for i, tx := range txs {
		require.Equal(t, nonce+uint64(i), tx.Nonce())
		require.Equal(t, wantData[i], tx.Data())
	}
}

func TestLibraryDeployment(t *testing.T) {
	parentBin, firstBin := ParentBin, FirstBin
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		nonce  *big.Int
		noSend bool
	}{
		{name: "pending"},
		{name: "explicit zero", nonce: big.NewInt(0)},
		{name: "explicit", nonce: big.NewInt(19)},
		{name: "large nonce", nonce: new(big.Int).SetUint64(1 << 63)},
		{name: "NoSend pending", noSend: true},
		{name: "NoSend explicit", nonce: big.NewInt(19), noSend: true},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			auth := deploymentAuth(t)
			auth.Nonce, auth.NoSend = tc.nonce, tc.noSend
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			auth.Context = ctx
			backend := &delayedBackend{nonce: 7}
			start, queries := backend.nonce, 1
			if auth.Nonce != nil {
				start, queries = auth.Nonce.Uint64(), 0
			}
			var signed []*types.Transaction
			signer := auth.Signer
			auth.Signer = func(address common.Address, tx *types.Transaction) (*types.Transaction, error) {
				tx, err := signer(address, tx)
				signed = append(signed, tx)
				return tx, err
			}
			addr, tx, contract, err := DeployParent(auth, backend)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NotNil(t, contract)
			require.Equal(t, crypto.CreateAddress(auth.From, start+3), addr)
			checkDeployment(t, auth.From, start, signed)
			require.Same(t, signed[3], tx)
			require.Equal(t, queries, backend.queries)
			if queries != 0 {
				require.Same(t, ctx, backend.ctx)
			}
			if tc.noSend {
				require.Empty(t, backend.sent)
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, signed, backend.sent)
			}
			if tc.nonce == nil {
				require.Nil(t, auth.Nonce)
			} else {
				require.Same(t, tc.nonce, auth.Nonce)
				require.Equal(t, start, auth.Nonce.Uint64())
			}
			require.Equal(t, parentBin, ParentBin)
			require.Equal(t, firstBin, FirstBin)
		})
	}
	for _, stage := range []int{-1, 0, 1, 2} {
		name := []string{"nonce error", "leaf error", "nested library error", "second library error"}[stage+1]
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			failure := errors.New("deployment failure")
			backend := &delayedBackend{sendErr: failure, failAt: stage}
			if stage == -1 {
				backend.nonceErr = failure
			}
			addr, tx, contract, err := DeployParent(deploymentAuth(t), backend)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, failure)
			require.Zero(t, addr)
			require.Nil(t, tx)
			require.Nil(t, contract)
			require.Len(t, backend.sent, stage+1)
			require.Equal(t, parentBin, ParentBin)
			require.Equal(t, firstBin, FirstBin)
		})
	}
	t.Run("repeat deployment and deployed code", func(t *testing.T) {
		auth := deploymentAuth(t)
		sim := backends.NewSimulatedBackend(types.GenesisAlloc{auth.From: {Balance: big.NewInt(1000000000000000000)}}, 10000000)
		defer sim.Close()
		backend := &delayedBackend{ContractBackend: sim}
		for round := uint64(0); round < 2; round++ {
			backend.nonce, backend.sent = round*4, nil
			_, _, _, err := DeployParent(auth, backend)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			checkDeployment(t, auth.From, backend.nonce, backend.sent)
			sim.Commit()
			for _, tx := range backend.sent {
				receipt, err := sim.TransactionReceipt(context.Background(), tx.Hash())
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, uint64(types.ReceiptStatusSuccessful), receipt.Status)
				addr := crypto.CreateAddress(auth.From, tx.Nonce())
				code, err := sim.CodeAt(context.Background(), addr, nil)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, tx.Data()[12:], code)
			}
			require.Nil(t, auth.Nonce)
			require.Equal(t, parentBin, ParentBin)
			require.Equal(t, firstBin, FirstBin)
		}
		require.Equal(t, 2, backend.queries)
	})
	t.Run("bytecode override", func(t *testing.T) {
		ParentBin = parentBin + "00"
		defer func() { ParentBin = parentBin }()
		auth := deploymentAuth(t)
		auth.Nonce, auth.NoSend = big.NewInt(0), true
		_, tx, _, err := DeployParent(auth, nil)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Len(t, tx.Data(), 12+41+1)
		require.Equal(t, byte(0), tx.Data()[len(tx.Data())-1])
		require.Equal(t, parentBin+"00", ParentBin)
	})
	t.Run("concurrent NoSend", func(t *testing.T) {
		auth := deploymentAuth(t)
		auth.Nonce, auth.NoSend = big.NewInt(7), true
		errs := make([]error, 8)
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for i := range errs {
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				_, _, _, errs[i] = DeployParent(auth, nil)
			}()
		}
		wg.Wait()
		for _, err := range errs {
			require.NoError(t, err)
		}
		require.Equal(t, int64(7), auth.Nonce.Int64())
		require.Equal(t, parentBin, ParentBin)
		require.Equal(t, firstBin, FirstBin)
	})
}

// ##
